notes:
• Added optional Discord webhook alerts for recovery and rejoin attempts.
• Improved wireless pairing, notification pairing and saved-device reconnection.
• Simplified Auto Recovery with per-instance settings and saved game targets.
• Added recovery-target detection when a usable Roblox game link is available.
• Improved touch-input handling during launches and recovery.
• Improved white-preview diagnostics and Retry preview handling.
• Added Start all and Restart running with spaced launches and restart confirmation.
• Improved Roblox rejoin sequencing for instances with Auto Recovery enabled.
• Redesigned Logs with clearer entries and instance/event filters.
• Matched instance numbering across Apps, Sessions and Logs.
• Improved clone-slot cleanup and clone-limit messages.
• Added timer-pause support for eligible paid keys after the last device logs out and the authorization grace period ends.
